doc: E5 (c): realised false-firing rates (percent) over 500 calibration draws per cell; cells[calibration pool->test pool] = list of entries (rule, n, alpha, subset of test rows, literal rule and rule with guards: mean, 5th, 95th percentile; bound; coverage of rephrases).
